specs.name: SSD
specs.value: Optional, supports M.2 2280 NVME SSD (PCI-E 3.0 x 2). If you use SSD, 4G/LTE will be disabled.

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 2.0 HOST, 2 x USB 3.0 HOST(The upper USB 3.0 port close to front panel also serves as a download interface)

specs.name: Audio
specs.value: 3.5mm Audio In/Out Connector, No Internal Speaker

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off.

specs.name: RS232
specs.value: Default to 2 x RS232. Up to 4 x RS232.

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: Default to 2 x RS485. Optionally, these 2 x RS485 can be configured to RS232.

specs.name: GPIO
specs.value: 6 channels non-isolated CPU GPIO, can be configured to IN or OUT by user

specs.name: 4G/LTE
specs.value: Supported, Optional. If you use 4G/LTE, SSD will be disabled.

specs.name: Mounting
specs.value: PPC-A55-101S (PN: CS12800-RK3568B2-101P): Panel, VESA, Wall, Desktop
